name: KAWACH
description: **KAWACH** (*कवच* — meaning **armour** / **shield** in Hindi) is a Flutter-based women & personal safety system that turns an everyday smartphone into an always-ready guardian. It blends **real-time emergency response**, **proactive risk prediction**, **offline-first resilience** and a **community safety network** into one calm fast safety app.

name: LUME
description: LUME is a predictive intelligence layer for land acquisition. Government already has systems that record project and acquisition data, but those systems mainly tell officers what has already happened. name: MedAether
description: MedÆther is a secure hospital coordination intelligence layer that sits on top of every hospital system — modern or 30-year-old legacy — and transforms fragmented bed data, transfer workflows, and blood requests into a single predictive, auditable, and failure-resistant emergency response network.

name: Nayana
description: Nayana (meaning "Eye" or "Vision") is a high-fidelity clinical platform designed for patients with limited mobility or speech impairments. By leveraging state-of-the-art Gaze Tracking AI, Nayana transforms eye movements into meaningful communication and provides clinicians with a real-time telemetry dashboard for remote monitoring.

name: SAATHI
description: SAATHI is an adaptive, voice-first, multilingual personal health companion that helps people understand, organize, remember, protect, and manage their healthcare throughout everyday life.  Healthcare does not only matter when someone is inside a hospital.  People continuously deal with:  medicines appointments prescriptions discharge instructions.

name: Sanchay
description: Sanchay is an open-source Android personal finance application designed to make everyday money management simple, intuitive, and customizable.  It helps you keep track of your income, expenses, accounts, budgets, planned payments, and financial goals — without turning personal finance into a complicated process.

name: SmartCart
description: SmartCart - An intelligent e-commerce platform featuring an AI assistant, smart bundle builder (knapsack algorithm), optimized route logistics, and real-time admin analytics. Built with Next.js, Express, and TypeScript.

name: TATTAVA
description: Tattva: AI-Powered Engineering Study Workspace is an intelligent study platform designed to help engineering students prepare efficiently for university semester exams. It leverages Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Gemini AI to transform textbooks, lecture slides, and syllabi into accurate, exam-focused study materials.

name: VIORIS
description: # The Vioris  **A private, auditable, voice-first personal operating agent.**  It is a coordinated system — voice layer, planner, memory, specialist agents, connectors, a computer operator, a mobile command center, and a strict permission engine, that lets you run real work across your laptop, phone, accounts, and apps by talking to one thing.
